desc:
Welcome to Suburban Weather Simulator, a game that simulates various weather disasters in Blox County. This game was calibrated to simulate common suburban weather disasters, including tornadoes, severe thunderstorms, flash floods, hurricanes, and more! Utilize custom NOAA weather radios, Emergency Alert Systems, and radar displays to help you observe storms like a pro and know when to take shelter.

📱 A graphics quality of 7 or greater is recommended for Suburban Weather Simulator.

🎧 Suburban Weather Simulator features realistic alert systems. Use of headphones or low volume is recommended when playing in public.

Created by @Weatherman109. Join the group to get a blue name tag and provide feedback: https://www.roblox.com/communities/33822833/Suburban-Weather-Simulator
